subject.title: Talk: add context-aware durable voice sessions

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this durable Talk ledger and confirmation model in core, and should the context-pack and legacy direct-auth additions be reviewed as separate changes?
rationale: The branch defines new persistent session semantics, public RPCs, configuration policy, action-confirmation behavior, and credential handling; code review cannot choose those long-term product and security contracts safely.

options.title: Split and sponsor the core ledger
options.body: Keep the durable session concept, fix run scoping and write reliability, and review context-pack and direct-auth behavior in separate focused proposals.

options.title: Sponsor the combined design
options.body: Retain the unified branch only with explicit Talk, mobile, and security owner approval plus fresh-install, upgrade, browser, and iOS proof.

options.title: Pause the direction
options.body: Close or park the branch and require a design issue before adding the persistent state, configuration, protocol, and credential surfaces.

recommendation.title: Split and sponsor the core ledger
recommendation.body: Keep the durable session concept, fix run scoping and write reliability, and review context-pack and direct-auth behavior in separate focused proposals.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main history signal covers the central Talk Gateway, protocol, and configuration decision surface.
